method: Serial end-to-end SQL calls including parse/bind/result; paired seeded query orders and rotating engine order; exact multiset oracle comparisons outside timers; first calls and setup separate; device profiling outside timers
limitations: One fresh process per workload/scale, within-process repetitions; no process-round confidence interval
First engine calls may share source/planner structures established by earlier engines
CUDA requested is not all-GPU: actual native devices and Python finalization are reported
GPU upload occurs in setup; all timed row data are resident
Unrelated user research processes remain running; no affinity or priority changes
